sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE SYNOPTIC UPPER PATTERN WILL UNDERGO AMPLIFICATION THURSDAY WITH A GRADUAL BUILDING OF THE RIDGE OVER THE WRN U.S. AND DEEPENING OF TROUGH OVER THE ERN STATES. SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE OH VALLEY REGION WILL MOVE SLOWLY EWD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC AND NERN STATES. OTHER VORTICITY MAXIMA WILL DROP SEWD THROUGH THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES REGION. AT THE SFC A COLD FRONT WILL DEVELOP SWD THROUGH KS AND THE MID MS VALLEY REGION WITH AN OCCLUDED FRONT FARTHER NORTH INTO WI. FARTHER EAST A SFC LOW WILL ACCOMPANY THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH INTO THE MID ATLANTIC REGION WITH A LEE TROUGH EXTENDING SWD FROM THE LOW THROUGH VA AND THE CAROLINAS.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN PLAINS THROUGH MID/LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF ELEVATED STORMS MAY BE ONGOING EARLY THURSDAY OVER ERN NEB WITHIN ZONE OF ISENTROPIC ASCENT ON NOSE OF SWLY LLJ. ACTIVITY COULD POSE A MODEST THREAT FOR MAINLY HAIL. UPPER 60S-LOW 70 DEWPOINTS ALREADY RESIDE IN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR BENEATH STEEP LAPSE RATES. STRONG DIABATIC WARMING SHOULD BOOST MLCAPE TO 3000-4000 J/KG IN PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR ACROSS MUCH OF KS INTO A PART OF THE MID MS VALLEY. EVOLUTION OF MORNING MCS IS UNCERTAIN...AND THIS ACTIVITY MIGHT DIMINISH AS THE LLJ WEAKENS...BUT ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY DEVELOP ALONG THE SWD ADVANCING FRONT AND POSSIBLY ALONG ANY RESIDUAL OUTFLOW FROM THE MORNING STORMS. THIS REGION WILL RESIDE WITHIN BELT OF 30-40 KT NWLY FLOW AT 500 MB AND 40+ KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR A FEW SUPERCELLS WITH INITIAL ACTIVITY...BUT STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY EVOLVE INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS. MAIN THREATS WILL BE DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL...INCLUDING POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL...BUT A SMALL WINDOW MAY EXIST FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES...ESPECIALLY OVER ERN KS. MCS/SEVERE THREAT MAY CONTINUE INTO THE EVENING...EVENTUALLY SPREADING INTO PARTS OF MO AND AR.

sections.title: WI THROUGH NRN IL AND IND
sections.text: THIS REGION WILL RESIDE WITHIN BELT OF NWLY FLOW ALOFT AND MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITHIN AMPLIFYING UPPER TROUGH AND WITHIN UPPER JET EXIT REGION. THE ATMOSPHERE WILL LIKELY BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND WEAKLY CAPPED AS DIABATIC WARMING COMMENCES. WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP BY AFTERNOON WITH UNIDIRECTIONAL NWLY SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF A FEW SUPERCELLS AND STORM SPLITS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS THE MAIN THREATS.

sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: DIABATIC WARMING OF THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL LIKELY SUPPORT MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY IN THIS REGION. STORMS WILL LIKELY REDEVELOP DURING THE AFTERNOON IN WARM SECTOR AND POSSIBLY ALONG REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM MCS CURRENTLY MOVING SWD THROUGH THE TN VALLEY. FLOW ALOFT WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY NWLY WITH VERTICAL SHEAR AT LEAST MARGINALLY SUPPORTIVE OF STORM ORGANIZATION. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS INTO EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC THROUGH A PORTION OF THE NERN STATES
sections.text: SEVERE THREAT IN THIS REGION IS SOMEWHAT UNCERTAIN. HOWEVER...LOW END SEVERE PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN MAINTAINED. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN MODEST...BUT FLOW ALOFT WILL UNDERGO SOME INCREASE AHEAD OF THE PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. DIABATIC WARMING WILL SUPPORT SOME DESTABILIZATION...BUT INSTABILITY WILL PROBABLY REMAIN SOMEWHAT MARGINAL DUE TO WEAK LAPSE RATES. STORMS WILL LIKELY REDEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE APPALACHIANS AND WITHIN CONVERGENCE ZONE ALONG LEE TROUGH AND SPREAD EWD. IF SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER OCCURS...THE STRONGER STORMS MAY POSE A THREAT FOR MAINLY ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..DIAL/LEITMAN.. 06/27/2013

sections.title: NEB/KS/WRN MO/OK/AR
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF DISCRETE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING THIS MORNING OVER EASTERN NEB. THESE STORMS FORMED A FEW HOURS AGO AHEAD OF A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH TOPPING THE RIDGE...AND IN A REGIME OF RATHER STRONG LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION. THESE STORMS WILL LIKELY PERSIST THROUGH MUCH OF THE MORNING AND SPREAD INTO PARTS OF MO/KS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS AT DDC/TOP/SGF SHOW STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR CAPABLE OF ISOLATED SEVERE WEATHER. BY LATE AFTERNOON...TEMPERATURES ACROSS MUCH OF KS WILL EXCEED 100F...WHICH SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO REACH CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURE AND YIELD ADDITIONAL SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS. A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND INCREASING NORTHERLY FLOW ALOFT SUGGEST THAT STORMS WILL POSE A RISK OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO SAG INTO AT LEAST NORTHERN OK/NORTHWEST AR BEFORE WEAKENING THIS EVENING.

sections.title: EASTERN STATES
sections.text: HAVE OPTED TO EXPAND SLGT RISK AREA OVER THE EASTERN U.S. FOR TODAY. AREAS OF STRONG HEATING WILL EXIST FROM SOUTHEAST NY INTO MUCH OF SC/GA/AL TODAY. THIS HEATING WILL HELP TO INITIATE ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE STORMS. MODERATE CAPE WILL BE PERVASIVE IN THIS REGION...ALONG WITH CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT AND VARIOUS REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. WHILE THE SPECIFIC DETAILS OF WHERE/WHEN STORMS WILL FORM IS UNCERTAIN...IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL FORM ALONG THIS CORRIDOR. DAMAGING WINDS ARE PROBABLY THE MAIN THREAT...BUT LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGEST CORES.

sections.title: WI INTO IL/IND
sections.text: A BELT OF NWLY FLOW ALOFT AND MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITHIN AN AMPLIFYING UPPER TROUGH ARE EXPECTED TO AFFECT THE WESTERN GREAT LAKES REGION TODAY. THE ATMOSPHERE WILL LIKELY BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND WEAKLY CAPPED AS DIABATIC WARMING COMMENCES. WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP BY AFTERNOON WITH UNIDIRECTIONAL NWLY SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF A FEW SUPERCELLS AND STORM SPLITS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS THE MAIN THREATS. ..HART/ROGERS.. 06/27/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: FURTHER AMPLIFICATION OF THE UPPER FLOW PATTERN ACROSS THE EASTERN PACIFIC INTO THE WESTERN U.S. IS FORECAST THROUGH THIS PERIOD. UPPER RIDGING EXTENDING NORTH OF A BROAD SUBTROPICAL HIGH CENTERED NEAR THE FOUR CORNERS REGION IS EXPECTED TO SHARPEN NORTHWARD ACROSS THE NORTHERN U.S. ROCKIES INTO ALBERTA. AS THIS OCCURS...THE FIRST COUPLE IN A SERIES OF MID/UPPER SPEED MAXIMUM...WITHIN A STRONG JET NOSING INLAND OFF THE PACIFIC AROUND THE CREST OF THE UPPER RIDGE...SHOULD CONTINUE TO DIG ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS TOWARD THE OHIO VALLEY. AN UPPER TROUGH...WITH AN EMBEDDED LOW/MID-LEVEL CYCLONE... ALREADY APPROACHING THE NORTHERN/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...SHOULD PROGRESS EASTWARD TOWARD NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS LATER TODAY...THEN NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD NEW ENGLAND TONIGHT...AS BROADER SCALE UPPER TROUGHING BEGINS TO AMPLIFY ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES AND OHIO VALLEY. MEANWHILE...A CONVECTIVELY GENERATED OR ENHANCED PERTURBATION TRAILING THE LEAD IMPULSE APPEARS LIKELY TO MIGRATE SOUTH SOUTHEASTWARD INTO/THROUGH EASTERN GULF COASTAL AREAS. ASSOCIATED WITH THIS EVOLVING PATTERN...STEEPEST MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...ASSOCIATED WITH VERY WARM AND STRONGLY CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR.

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS INTO OZARK PLATEAU
sections.text: ISOLATED SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT IS ALREADY UNDERWAY ACROSS PARTS OF THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY. THIS APPEARS IN RESPONSE TO FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A ZONE OF ENHANCED LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION ON THE NORTHEASTERN PERIPHERY OF THE SUBTROPICAL HIGH...AND THE STRONGER CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN PLAINS. THIS IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY...WITH UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH POSSIBLE INTO ONE OR TWO SUBSTANTIVE SOUTHWARD PROPAGATING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS...BENEATH MODERATELY STRONG NORTHWESTERLY MID/UPPER FLOW. DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORM DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. GIVEN THE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES...CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...LARGE CAPE...AND SIZABLE SUB-CLOUD TEMPERATURE-DEW POINT SPREADS...STRONGEST STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL...PERHAPS WIND DRIVEN...ALONG WITH STRONG SURFACE COLD POOLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING SWATHS OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: ERN GULF STATES AND APPALACHIANS TO ATLANTIC SEABOARD
sections.text: DEEP LAYER SHEAR ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN WEAK THROUGH THE PERIOD. HOWEVER...FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE MAIN IMPULSE TURNING EAST OF THE NORTH CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...COUPLED WITH AN ASSOCIATED BELT OF MODEST LOWER/MID-LEVEL FLOW...COULD ENHANCE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT LATE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF EASTERN VIRGINIA/MARYLAND AND THE DELMARVA PENINSULA INTO NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS. A LINE OR CLUSTER OF STORMS APPEARS POSSIBLE...WITH THE RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. OTHER SCATTERED STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT STILL APPEARS POSSIBLE IN THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY...NORTHWARD INTO UPSTATE NEW YORK...AND SOUTHWARD...TO THE SOUTH AND EAST OF THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED PERTURBATION COULD CONTRIBUTE TO ANOTHER CLUSTER OVER STORMS TODAY ACROSS PARTS OF ALABAMA AND GEORGIA...WHICH COULD PERHAPS DEVELOP SOUTHWARD INTO NORTHERN FLORIDA.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST INTO GREAT LAKES
sections.text: WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STRENGTHENING DEEP LAYER SHEAR ...TO THE CYCLONIC SIDE OF THE MID/UPPER JET STREAK NOSING SOUTHWARD THROUGH THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...MAY CONTRIBUTE TO SCATTERED STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT TODAY INTO TONIGHT. THIS MAY INCLUDE A COUPLE OF SUPERCELLS. ..KERR/GRAMS.. 06/27/2013

sections.title: DISCUSSION
sections.text: FEW CHANGES ARE BEING MADE THIS FORECAST WITH THE EXCEPTION OF TWEAKS TO THE LINES BASED ON LATEST TRENDS. THE MAIN ADDITION HAS BEEN TO ADD 5% TORNADO PROBABILITY TO THE SOUTHEAST PA/NERN MD/NJ/DE AREA...CONSISTENT WITH EXISTING TORNADO WATCH 377. OTHERWISE...STORMS CONTINUE TO EVOLVE AS ANTICIPATED...WITH NEW DEVELOPMENT ONGOING INVOF THE CENTRAL U.S. MODERATE RISK AREA. POTENTIAL FOR SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE WEATHER -- MAINLY IN THE FORM OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS -- REMAINS APPARENT THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. ..GOSS.. 06/27/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1123 AM CDT THU JUN 27 2013/

THIS MAY INCLUDE A COUPLE OF SUPERCELLS.

sections.title: KS AND OK THROUGH WRN MO AND NRN/CNTRL AR
sections.text: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL PERSIST UNTIL AROUND 03-04Z OVER NRN OK AS LINEAR MCS MOVES SWD THROUGH A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. EVENING RAOB DATA FROM NORMAN SHOWS 4000 J/KG MLCAPE. HOWEVER...AS THE SFC LAYER BEGINS TO COOL...CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL UNDERGO A SUBSTANTIAL INCREASE...WHICH WILL LIKELY CONTRIBUTE TO A GRADUAL WEAKENING AND EVENTUAL DEMISE OF STORMS. OTHER STORMS ARE DEVELOPING NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY OVER NERN KS. SOME POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR THIS ACTIVITY TO CONGEAL INTO AN MCS AND FORWARD PROPAGATE SSEWD THROUGH ERN KS AND WRN MO. IF THIS OCCURS A MORE WIDESPREAD WIND THREAT WOULD EXIST. HOWEVER...CONFIDENCE IN THIS SCENARIO IS NOT PARTICULARLY HIGH DUE TO INCREASING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION AND LIKELIHOOD OF ONLY A MODEST WLY LLJ OVERNIGHT. OTHER STORMS MAY DEVELOP LATER TONIGHT OVER WRN MO/NRN AR WITHIN ZONE OF WEAK WARM ADVECTION ON ERN FRINGE OF WARMER AIR ALOFT. SHOULD THEY DEVELOP...THESE STORMS WILL LIKELY BE SLIGHTLY ELEVATED BUT MAY POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: GREAT LAKES REGION
sections.text: STORMS DEVELOPING WITHIN WEAKLY CAPPED NWLY FLOW REGIME AND MODEST INSTABILITY OVER THE GREAT LAKES ARE MOSTLY DIURNAL IN NATURE AND SHOULD CONTINUE A WEAKENING TREND WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS THROUGH AROUND 02Z.

sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH MID EVENING WITH WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS FROM THE SERN STATES THROUGH THE CAROLINAS AND SERN VA. HOWEVER...A STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER WILL RESULT IN A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND. ..DIAL.. 06/28/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INCREASING SVR THREAT IS POSSIBLE ACROSS DISCUSSION AREA AS LOW-LEVEL AIR MASS DESTABILIZES. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS...SOMETIMES NEAR SVR LIMITS...ARE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NEARLY UNCAPPED AND INCREASINGLY BUOYANT AIR MASS FROM SC TO ERN MS WILL SUPPORT RISK FOR DEVELOPMENT OF SFC-BASED CONVECTION THROUGH EARLY-MID AFTN PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS. UPSCALE GROWTH IS POSSIBLE INTO LARGER CLUSTERS OFFERING DAMAGING-WIND RISK. VIS IMAGERY INDICATES TWO PRIMARY INITIAL AREAS OF CONVECTIVE CONCERN... 1. NRN GA AND NERN AL....ALONG DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE THAT COINCIDES WITH SEWD EXTENSION OF EARLIER CONVECTION...SHIFTING SEWD...AND 2. INVOF MCV THAT ALSO IS EVIDENT IN REFLECTIVITY ANIMATIONS OVER SERN AL...NEAR AUO. THIS FEATURE WILL PROCEED TOWARD GULF COAST OF CENTRAL FL PANHANDLE...AND MAY AID IN CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION FROM THAT REGION INTO SRN AL. OTHER CONVECTION IS LIKELY TO DEVELOP ALONG MORE SUBTLE FEATURES WITHIN NEARLY UNCAPPED AIR MASS FROM SC TO ERN MS. MORE KINEMATIC AND DYNAMIC SUPPORT FOR ORGANIZED SVR POTENTIAL...COMPARED TO PREVIOUS DAYS...IS EVIDENT THROUGH AT LEAST EARLY-MID AFTN. COOLING ALOFT...MIDLEVEL WINDS AND DEEP SHEAR EACH WERE ENHANCED IN BMX RAOB...I.E. 35-50 KT JETLET IN 450-600 MB LAYER AND NEARLY -12 C 500-MB TEMP -- BY PROXIMAL PASSAGE OF MCV...WITHIN SRN FRINGES OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH EXTENDING NNEWD OVER OH. MEANWHILE...IN BROADER/MESO-ALPHA SCALE ENVIRONMENT...STRONGLY DIFLUENT MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW IS EVIDENT IN MORNING RAOB ANALYSES AND MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY...AHEAD OF TROUGH ALOFT. DCVA AND ACCOMPANYING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT/DESTABILIZATION WILL ACT IN TANDEM WITH STG INSOLATION OF MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEW POINTS 70S F AND TEMPS RISING INTO UPPER 80S/90S NEAR THERMAL AXIS...YIELDING MLCAPE 2500-3500 J/KG IN MODIFIED RAOBS AND MODEL SOUNDINGS. ENHANCEMENTS TO MIDLEVEL FLOW RELATED TO APCH OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH ALSO WILL STRENGTHEN DEEP SHEAR. STORM MODE SHOULD BE PRIMARI

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONTINUE WW. THOUGH PRIMARY SVR THREAT SHOULD REMAIN IN WW FOR ANOTHER 2-3 HOURS...ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS MAY OCCUR WITH TRAILING TSTMS INITIALLY OVER E-CENTRAL NEB...AND MOVING SEWD TOWARD SERN NEB/SWRN IA/NWRN MO AREA. LEADING CONVECTION...WHICH ALREADY HAS PRODUCED REPORTS OF 4.25 INCH HAIL AND GUSTS NEAR 65 KT OVER SERN NEB AND NERN KS RESPECTIVELY...MAY REMAIN SVR AS IT MOVES ALONG NERN MARGINS OF MOST UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND EXITS WW OVER WRN/CENTRAL MO EARLY THIS AFTN. AS SUCH...ADDITIONAL WW MAY BE REQUIRED FARTHER SE. ALSO...AREAS W OF WW OVER KS WILL BE MONITORED FOR INCREASING SVR THREAT ALONG AND W OF RESULTING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND SE OF COLD FRONT DESCRIBED BELOW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWS WEAK LOW OVER MKC AREA...NEAR LEADING EDGE OF SVR TSTM CLUSTER MOVING SEWD. WEAK/QUASISTATIONARY BAROCLINIC ZONE AND ACCOMPANYING/BETTER-DEFINED THETAE BOUNDARY EXTEND SEWD FROM THAT LOW ACROSS S-CENTRAL MO. OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING BOUNDARY ARCS FROM NWRN MO/NERN KS CONVECTION ACROSS MHK/CNK AREAS THEN INTO S-CENTRAL NEB...AND SHOULD DECELERATE SOONER WITH WWD EXTENT. SFC LOW WAS ANALYZED BETWEEN MCK-LBF WITH COLD FRONT SWWD ACROSS NWRN KS. FRONT EXTENDS GENERALLY EWD TO INTERSECT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER S-CENTRAL NEB. OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SHOULD ALIGN ITSELF NW-SE ACROSS NRN/ERN KS WITH TIME...PARALLEL TO THETAE GRADIENT INITIALLY TO ITS E...AS ADDITIONAL FOCUS FOR LATER CONVECTION. THOUGH LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS WEAK...VWP AND FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST STG VEERING WITH HEIGHT INVOF THAT BOUNDARY...AMIDST LOW-LEVEL WAA PROFILE. POCKETS OF 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDE ARE EVIDENT ALONG AND W OF BOUNDARIES...WHERE SFC DEW POINTS MID-70S F AND TEMPS RISING INTO 90S WILL BUILD STG-EXTREME INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE VALUES EXCEEDING 4000 J/KG BY EARLY AFTN. VIS IMAGERY ALSO INDICATES INITIALLY ELEVATED CONVECTION OVER CENTRAL KS THAT MAY BECOME SFC-BASED W OF OUTFLOW. ..EDWARDS.. 06/27/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY WILL INCREASE IN ASSOCIATION WITH AN MCV SHIFTING NEWD FROM NRN VA. STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ALONG WITH CONTINUED DOWNSTREAM DESTABILIZATION SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS WITH A PRIMARY RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 16Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A 1006 MB CYCLONE NEAR THE MD PANHANDLE WITH AN MCV EVIDENT IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY ACROSS NRN VA AHEAD OF THE BROADER MID-LEVEL TROUGH CROSSING THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS. SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVE HEATED WELL INTO THE 80S DOWNSTREAM OF THE THICKER CLOUD DECKS ASSOCIATED WITH THE MCV AND ALONG THE APPALACHIANS. A NARROW BELT OF MODERATELY STRONG MID-LEVEL SWLYS /AROUND 30-35 KT/ WAS SAMPLED IN CCX/BGM VWP DATA AND THIS ENHANCEMENT SHOULD SHIFT EWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. MEANWHILE...STRONGER LOW-LEVEL FLOW SAMPLED IN AKQ VWP DATA SHOULD DEVELOP NEWD ALONG THE COASTAL PLAIN. SETUP MAY YIELD SEVERAL CLUSTERS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AS THE MAIN HAZARDS...WITH PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO POSSIBLE WITH TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES NEAR THE ATLANTIC COAST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED CONVECTION FORMING ALONG THE SEA BREEZE AND INLAND OVER THE PIEDMONT SHOULD YIELD LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL INTO EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MODIFIED 12Z RAOBS SUGGEST AIR MASS HAS BECOME MODERATE TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE ACROSS THE ERN CAROLINAS WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES HAVING WARMED INTO THE LOWER 90S. TSTMS HAVE RECENTLY FORMED ALONG THE SC SEA BREEZE WITH MORE ISOLATED CONVECTION INLAND ACROSS THE PIEDMONT. WITH THE REGION LYING IN BETWEEN MCV/S OVER NRN VA AND SWRN GA...DEEP-LAYER FLOW SHOULD REMAIN MODEST WITH SHORT HODOGRAPHS EVIDENT IN AREA VWP DATA. THIS WILL LIKELY LIMIT STORM-SCALE ORGANIZATION...BUT THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY SHOULD SUPPORT LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR POTENTIAL MAY INCREASE THROUGH AFTN OVER DISCUSSION AREA TO EXTENT THAT INITIALLY ISOLATED CONVECTION OVER PARTS OF NRN AND CENTRAL WI CAN GROW UPSCALE WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE. MAIN CONCERNS ARE LARGE HAIL AND SPORADIC DAMAGING GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC PATTERN IS RATHER SUBTLE AND FRAGMENTED ACROSS THIS AREA...WITH POCKETS OF STRONGER VERSUS WEAKER MOISTURE/MIXING AND HEATING AWAY FROM LM MARINE LAYER. MODEL FCST SOUNDINGS AND MODIFIED RAOBS SUGGEST AIR MASS ACROSS THIS REGION ESSENTIALLY HAS LOST MLCINH. SFC DEW POINTS HAVE MIXED DOWN A FEW DEG F DURING LAST 1-2 HOURS FROM PEAK VALUES AT SEVERAL STATIONS IN WI...OFFSET ENOUGH BY SFC DIABATIC HEATING TO MAINTAIN MLCAPE 1000-2000 J/KG. BUOYANCY SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY MAXIMIZED WITHIN ABOUT 75 NM EITHER SIDE OF MOISTURE/THETAE AXIS DRAWN FROM SERN IL NNWWD ACROSS S-CENTRAL/WRN WI. WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYER WILL SUPPORT DOWNDRAFT ACCELERATION AS WELL AS MAINTENANCE TO SFC OF ANY SVR HAIL GENERATED ALOFT. VEERED LOW-LEVEL WINDS WILL LIMIT BOUNDARY-LAYER CONVERGENCE AND HODOGRAPH SIZE. HOWEVER...DEEP SHEAR IS ENHANCED AROUND SRN RIM OF MID-UPPER PERTURBATION THAT IS EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER LS. THAT...ALONG WITH BUILDING RIDGE OVER SWRN CONUS...SHOULD MAINTAIN ENHANCED GRADIENT FLOW ALOFT FOR EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES RANGING FROM AROUND 60 KT OVER WRN WI TO AROUND 30 KT OVER WRN LM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS MAY INCREASE SOMEWHAT INTO EARLY EVENING WITH GRADUAL EWD-MOVING MULTICELL CLUSTERS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IN ASSOCIATION WITH A REMNANT MCV OVER SWRN GA...CONVECTION HAS INCREASED IN COVERAGE WITHIN TWO SEPARATED CLUSTERS IN SRN GA. 0-5 KM AGL FLOW IS ANEMIC DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY...BUT 30 KT OF MID-LEVEL N/NWLYS SAMPLED IN EOX VWP DATA SHOULD SUPPORT CONTINUED MULTICELL ORGANIZATION GIVEN LOWER TO MIDDLE 90S SURFACE TEMPERATURES. THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT SHOULD REMAIN RELATIVELY LOCALIZED AND CONFINED TO MICROBURSTS. BUT THIS THREAT COULD INCREASE IN SERN GA IF MERGING OF THE COLD POOLS FROM THE TWO CLUSTERS OCCURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO SHOULD GRADUALLY DEVELOP E/NEWD ACROSS PRIMARILY ERN PA/MD...DE AND NJ. A DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE IS PROBABLE BY EARLY EVENING IN PORTIONS OF NERN PA TO SRN NY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONGEST/LONGEST-LIVED HIGH REFLECTIVITY CORES HAVE PERSISTED IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF AN MCV CENTERED JUST S OF UNV AS OF 1945Z. CO-LOCATED WITH THE PRIMARY SURFACE CYCLONE AND WITH MODEST SURFACE PRESSURE FALLS DOWNSTREAM...A SUPERCELL WAS NOTED EARLIER IN JUNIATA/PERRY COUNTY PA BUT HAS SINCE DISSIPATED. SUFFICIENT LOW/MID-LEVEL SHEAR HAS BEEN SAMPLED BY CCX VWP DATA TO SUPPORT TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AMIDST A RELATIVELY CHAOTIC CONVECTIVE MODE. WITH ADDITIONAL TSTMS DEVELOPING IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SECOND MCV SHIFTING NEWD ACROSS CNTRL MD AND RELATIVELY PROMINENT CU FIELD DOWNSTREAM IN THE NORTHEAST...STRONG TO SEVERE CONVECTION WILL LIKELY BE SUSTAINED FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. A CONSOLIDATED CLUSTER MAY ULTIMATELY EVOLVE NEWD WITH A RISK FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. TO THE SW OF THE MCV/S...SEVERE THREAT IS NIL AND PORTIONS OF WW IN VA/DC COULD BE SAFELY CLEARED. ..GRAMS.. 06/27/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR THREAT SHOULD INCREASE ACROSS WW AREAS...PARTICULARLY KS PORTION...DURING REMAINDER MID-LATE AFTN. MIXTURE OF QUASI-LINEAR AND CLUSTERED MODES IS POSSIBLE...WITH SOME SUPERCELL-FAVORABLE CONDITIONS OVER ERN KS. THREAT FOR LARGE AND OCCASIONALLY SIGNIFICANT/DAMAGING HAIL WILL EXIST...TRANSITIONING TO DAMAGING WIND...WITH SOME OVERLAP POSSIBLE. ADDITIONAL WW MAY BE REQUIRED WITHIN NEXT 2-3 HOURS FOR PORTIONS NRN OK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWED HEAT-AIDED FRONTAL-WAVE LOW BETWEEN HLC-CNK...WITH COLD FRONT SWWD ACROSS W-CENTRAL KS TO LAA AREA IN SERN CO. COLD FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE MOVING SEWD ACROSS CENTRAL/SERN KS...PRECEDED BY INCREASINGLY WELL-DEFINED CONVECTIVE BOUNDARY ARISING FROM TSTMS THAT HAVE INITIATED INVOF FRONT. SFC MAP ALSO SHOWED TWO PRIMARY OUTFLOW FEATURES... 1. BLENDED OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM DECAYING CONVECTION OVER S-CENTRAL MO...NWWD ACROSS ERN KS NEAR EMP...TO BETWEEN SLN-MHK. BOUNDARY HAS DECELERATED AND IS MOVING SLOWLY SWWD...AND ALSO HAS MODIFIED WITH FAVORABLY MOIST/BUOYANT AIR TO ITS IMMEDIATE NE. 2. FRESHER OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM S-CENTRAL NEB NEAR HDE...SEWD ACROSS MHK AREA...THEN BECOMING DIFFUSE ENEWD TOWARD STJ. THIS BOUNDARY WAS PRODUCED LARGELY BY CONVECTION NOW WEAKENING NEAR MHK...IS MOVING SWWD 15-20 KT ACROSS KS/NEB BORDER AND TOWARD SLN...AND INTERSECTS FRONTAL ZONE INVOF NEWER CONVECTION OVER SMITH/OSBORNE COUNTIES KS. AIR MASS S OF FRONT AND OUTFLOWS TRANSITIONS FROM VERY HIGH-MOISTURE CONTENT AND ADEQUATELY HEATED INVOF MO BOUNDARY TO VERY HOT...WITH MODERATE MOISTURE CONTENT AND DEEP MIXED LAYER OVER WRN KS. MODIFIED FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST MLCAPE RANGES FROM AROUND 1500 J/KG OVER SWRN KS TO 4000 J/KG IN S-CENTRAL KS AND EXTREME N-CENTRAL OK...TO NARROW CORRIDOR OF 5000-6000 J/KG ON E SIDE OF FIRST OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER SRN/WRN MO. SHARP DECREASE IN BUOYANCY IS NOTED WITH NEWD EXTENT OVER CENTRAL/SRN MO. RELATED INSTABILITY GRADIENT SHOULD FORM EFFECTIVE ERN BOUND FOR SUBSTANTIAL SVR POTENTIAL...WHILE AREA OF TSTMS EXPANDS/INTENSIFIES ACROSS KS AND EVENTUALLY INTO PORTIONS NRN OK. DIFLUENT MID-UPPER FLOW STILL IS STRONG ENOUGH TO SUPPORT 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES OVER MUCH OF THIS REGION. ..EDWARDS

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONGER STORMS MAY CONTINUE TO POSE DOWNBURST THREAT THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS WITH SPORADIC DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE. AS DAYTIME HEATING WANES...STORMS WILL WEAKEN INTO THE EVENING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SPORADIC INSTANCES OF DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS AS STORMS TRACK E/SE ACROSS THE MCD AREA TOWARD THE ATLANTIC COAST. STRONG INSTABILITY AND A MOIST/HOT DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS SHOULD SUSTAIN ONGOING CONVECTION A WHILE LONGER. HOWEVER...WEAK DEEP LAYER FLOW IS GENERALLY LIMITING ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT. HIGH PW VALUES APPROACHING 2 INCHES WILL HELP PROMOTE STRONG DOWNBURSTS AND DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL IN STRONGER CELLS. AS DAYTIME HEATING CONTINUES TO WANE...STORMS SHOULD BEGIN TO WEAKEN AS BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DOWNBURSTS/WIND DAMAGE AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH EARLY EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF EASTERN/CENTRAL AR AND NORTHERN MS/FAR SOUTHWEST TN. SOME UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING THE EXTENT/MAGNITUDE OF THE SEVERE RISK...BUT A SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED SHOULD STORMS CONTINUE TO INCREASE/ORGANIZE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: COINCIDENT WITH A CORRIDOR OF WEAK CONVERGENCE/CONFLUENCE...A CLUSTER OF STORMS HAS EVOLVED SINCE 21-2130Z ACROSS NORTHEAST AR. THE AIRMASS ESPECIALLY ON THE WESTERN/SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF THESE STORMS IS QUITE HOT/UNSTABLE...WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES AROUND 100 F AND SURFACE DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE LOWER/MIDDLE 70S F. ESTIMATES ARE THAT MLCAPE EXCEEDS 3000 J/KG. WHILE DEEP TROPOSPHERIC FLOW IS RELATIVELY WEAK...A BIT STRONGER LOW-MID LEVEL NORTHERLY WINDS HAVE BEEN NOTED WITHIN WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM MEMPHIS WITH AROUND 30 KT BETWEEN 3-6 KM. THIS ASIDE...THE HOT/UNSTABLE NATURE OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER AND MODEST WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY L0W-LEVEL MASS INFLOW WILL LIKELY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A SOUTHWARD CONTINUANCE/POSSIBLE EXPANSION OF AT LEAST A LOOSELY ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTER THROUGH EARLY EVENING. ISOLATED DOWNBURSTS/WIND DAMAGE WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD ASIDE FROM THE POSSIBILITY OF SOME MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY CONTINUE THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS WW 377 AND INTO ADJACENT AREAS OF SRN NY/LONG ISLAND. THREAT SHOULD BEGIN TO DIMINISH INTO THE EVENING HOURS AND A NEW WW IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION ACROSS ERN PA INTO NJ HAS REMAINED LOOSELY ORGANIZED MAINLY DUE TO PRESENCE OF MCV AND ADEQUATE DEEP LAYER FLOW. HOWEVER...STORMS HAVE NOT SHOWN SIGNS OF SEVERE CHARACTERISTICS /EXCEPT IN ISOLATED INSTANCES ACROSS PARTS OF PA/ FOR AT LEAST THE LAST HOUR OR SO. WHILE STORMS MAY BE MAINTAINED AS THEY TRACK TOWARD THE E/NE INTO A MOIST AND UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...SEVERE THREAT REMAINS QUESTIONABLE. WHILE PARTS OF SRN NY IN WRN LONG ISLAND HAVE REMAINED UNDER MOSTLY CLEAR TO SCATTERED CLOUDINESS...MUCH OF THE REST OF SRN NEW ENGLAND HAS HAD CLOUD COVER TODAY...AND COOLER TEMPERATURES ARE NOTED COMPARED TO THOSE ACROSS SE PA INTO NJ. ADDITIONALLY...WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL BEGIN TO COOL/STABILIZE. SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE MARGINAL AS STORMS TRACK TOWARD THE NYC METRO AND SRN NY. THEREFORE...A WW IS NOT EXPECTED DOWNSTREAM OF WW 377 AT THIS TIME...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE/BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL WILL REMAIN A POSSIBILITY ACROSS EASTERN WI/NORTHEAST IL INTO WESTERN LOWER MI/NORTHERN INDIANA AND WESTERN/NORTHERN PORTIONS OF OH THROUGH THE 02Z-03Z TIME FRAME. THE NEED FOR A WATCH CANNOT BE ENTIRELY DISCOUNTED...BUT THE WIDELY SCATTERED NATURE OF THE STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS IS CURRENTLY EXPECTED TO PRECLUDE A WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF AN UPPER LOW OVER MANITOBA/NORTHERN ONTARIO...A NORTHWESTERLY MID-HIGH LEVEL SPEED MAX APPEARS TO BE SPREADING SOUTHEASTWARD OVER THE UPPER GREAT LAKES PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. THIS IS A FACTOR IS STORM PERSISTENCE LATE THIS AFTERNOON AS STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO SPREAD GENERALLY SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH EARLY/MID EVENING COINCIDENT WITH RELATIVELY UNIFORM WESTERLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW...ASIDE FROM A WEST-SOUTHWESTWARD PROPAGATING OUTFLOW/EXPANDING COLD POOL ACROSS EASTERN LOWER MI/ADJACENT FAR NORTHERN OH. GIVEN THE WARM/MOIST NATURE OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER...MLCAPE IS LIKELY AS HIGH AS 1500-2500 J/KG ACROSS EASTERN WI/NORTHEAST IL INTO MUCH OF INDIANA/WESTERN LOWER MI AND WESTERN OH. OVERALL ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN CONDUCIVE FOR SUSTAINED MULTICELLS/TRANSIENT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE/SEVERE HAIL. WHILE SEVERE TSTMS ARE LIKELY TO PERSIST ON A WIDELY SCATTERED BASIS THROUGH EARLY/PARTS OF MID-EVENING...A WATCH DOES NOT APPEAR IMMINENT BARRING ADDITIONAL INTENSIFICATION/ORGANIZATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ASIDE FROM BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS ARE A DISTINCT CONCERN THROUGH EARLY/MID EVENING ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL KS/EASTERN TX PANHANDLE AND MUCH OF NORTHERN OK. SEVERE TSTM WATCHES 378 AND 379 CONTINUE UNTIL 03Z...AND A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH IS LIKELY ACROSS ADDITIONAL PORTIONS OF NORTHEAST OK /PROBABLE BEFORE 01Z/.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A 180-MILE NORTHEAST-SOUTHWEST EXTENSIVE MCS CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY ORGANIZE/ACCELERATE SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL KS AND SOUTHWEST KS/NORTHWEST OK BORDER VICINITY AS OF 2340Z...WITH A CURRENT FORWARD MOTION NOW AS HIGH AS 35-40 KT. A 51 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY MEASURED AT HUTCHINSON KS...WITH A 55 KT GUST AT BUFFALO OK. AHEAD OF THIS MCS...LOW-LEVEL MASS RESPONSE APPEARS TO BE OCCURRING ACROSS NORTHERN OK/FAR SOUTH-CENTRAL KS OVER THE PAST 1-2 HR PER SURFACE DATA TRENDS AND WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM WICHITA...WITH INCREASING SOUTHEASTERLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS BOOSTING STORM-RELATIVE LOW-LEVEL INFLOW COINCIDENT WITH A HOT/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER. THE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE MCS IS QUITE UNSTABLE ESPECIALLY ACROSS FAR SOUTH-CENTRAL/SOUTHEAST KS AND THE EASTERN HALF OF OK...WHERE MLCAPE LIKELY EXCEEDS 4000 J/KG. COLD POOL EXPANSION ASIDE...THIS SCENARIO WILL LIKELY LEAD TO ADDITIONAL PROPAGATION/SOUTHEASTWARD FORWARD ACCELERATION THROUGH EARLY/MID EVENING ESPECIALLY ACROSS FAR SOUTH-CENTRAL KS/PERHAPS SOUTHEAST KS AND MUCH OF NORTHERN OK INCLUDING THE I-35 CORRIDOR. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE A DISTINCT POSSIBILITY. ..GUYER.. 06/27/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WINDS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH ONGOING STORMS/LEADING OUTFLOW ESPECIALLY ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL/NORTHEAST OK INTO PORTIONS OF CENTRAL OK THIS EVENING. MEANWHILE...LARGE HAIL REMAINS POSSIBLE ACROSS NORTHEAST KS ALTHOUGH DAMAGING WINDS MAY BECOME MORE OF A CONCERN THROUGH 03Z /AND POTENTIALLY BEYOND/ ACROSS EASTERN KS/FAR WESTERN MO. SEVERE TSTM WATCHES 378/379 CONTINUE UNTIL 03Z...WHILE SEVERE TSTM WATCH 380 CONTINUES UNTIL 05Z. A SPATIAL EXTENSION OF WATCHES 379/380 MAY BE WARRANTED ACROSS OK...AND/OR A TEMPORAL EXTENSION/REPLACEMENT WATCH COULD BE NEEDED FOR EASTERN KS AND PERHAPS FAR WESTERN MO BEYOND 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS OF 0145Z...A SEVERE MCS/LEADING OUTFLOW CONTINUES TO STEADILY PROGRESS SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE NORTHERN THIRD OF OK AND ADJACENT PARTS OF THE NORTHERN TX PANHANDLE. DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE...PERHAPS INTO CENTRAL OK...OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. RECENT SEVERE-CALIBER MEASURED GUSTS INCLUDE 58 KT AT REDROCK OK AND PAWNEE OK. THAT SAID...THE INTEGRITY OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE HAS BEGUN TO DIMINISH...SUCH THAT THE INTENSITY/EXTENSIVENESS OF THE SEVERE GUSTS SHOULD CONTINUE TO TREND DOWNWARD AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER...WHILE STILL RELATIVELY WARM/UNSTABLE...GRADUALLY COOLS. MEANWHILE...A VERY PERSISTENT CLUSTER OF STORMS ATOP PRIOR OUTFLOW ACROSS NORTHEAST KS CONTINUES TO EXPAND IN COVERAGE AND GROW UPSCALE. LARGE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE IN THE SHORT TERM AND/OR ON THE PERIPHERY OF THE EVOLVING CLUSTER...BUT DAMAGING WINDS...AT LEAST ON AN ISOLATED BASIS...SHOULD BECOME MORE OF A CONCERN AS FORWARD PROPAGATION ENSUES INTO A RELATIVELY UNSTABLE/UNPERTURBED AIRMASS TO ITS SOUTH-SOUTHEAST. ALONG THESE LINES...A 60 KT GUST WAS RECENTLY MEASURED AT FORT RILEY KS. A TEMPORAL WATCH EXTENSION BEYOND 03Z OR A REPLACEMENT WATCH MAY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE HOUR FOR EASTERN KS AND PERHAPS PARTS OF FAR WESTERN MO. ..GUYER.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH 381 CONTINUES UNTIL 08Z WITH AT LEAST ISOLATED BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL/LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS ACROSS FAR SOUTHEAST KS INTO PORTIONS OF SOUTHWEST/WEST-CENTRAL MO. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WATCH EXPANSION OR A NEW WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LOOSELY ORGANIZED SEMI-BROKEN CLUSTER OF STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS FAR SOUTHEAST KS AND SOUTHWEST/WEST-CENTRAL MO EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT. THIS ACTIVITY COINCIDES WITH AN EFFECTIVE FRONTAL ZONE...WITH THE NORTHEASTERN PORTION OF THE CLUSTER INTERACTING WITH THE INFLUENCE OF EARLIER OUTFLOW FROM AFTERNOON STORMS. EARLY EVENING 00Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS SAMPLED A STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATE/STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT...WITH THE 00Z SPRINGFIELD MO SOUNDING INDICATIVE OF 7.9 C/KM WITH AROUND 2500 J/KG MLCAPE. EVEN WHILE THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAS GRADUALLY COOLED/STABILIZED SINCE THAT TIME...SUFFICIENT LAPSE RATES/INSTABILITY IN CONJUNCTION WITH A BELT OF MODERATELY STRONG NORTHWESTERLY FLOW MAY ALLOW FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF SEMI-ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL/LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. ..GUYER.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WING OF ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS IS DEVELOPING EWD AHEAD OF A QLCS LOCATED OVER WCNTRL/CNTRL MO. THIS MAY INDICATE THAT THE QLCS WILL PROPAGATE INTO PORTIONS OF SERN MO DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. IF THIS OCCURS...AN ADDITIONAL WW MAY NEED TO BE ISSUED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 06Z...SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOWED A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDED ESEWD FROM CNTRL/SRN MO INTO FAR SRN IL. TEMPERATURES ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE FRONT ARE IN THE MID 70S TO AROUND 80F...WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S. THIS AIRMASS CONTINUES TO SUPPORT A RESERVOIR OF SUBSTANTIAL MLCAPE /1500-3000 J PER KG/ FROM CNTRL MO INTO CNTRL AR. A QLCS IS ONGOING INVOF OF THE FRONT...WITH 40 KT MIDLEVEL NWLY FLOW AIDING IN DRIVING THIS SYSTEM SEWD INTO THE UNSTABLE AIRMASS. IN ADDITION...HI-RES RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A WING OF CONVECTION DEVELOPING EWD FROM THE QLCS. THIS MAY INDICATE THAT A PORTION OF THE QLCS WILL PROPAGATE INTO SERN MO DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. IF THIS OCCURS...THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS WOULD EXIST E OF WW 382...AND MAY NECESSITATE THE ISSUANCE OF AN ADDITIONAL WW. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PORTIONS OF NRN/CNTRL AR ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PER MCD 1279...THE AIRMASS LOCATED S OF A QLCS POSITIONED OVER THE SRN HALF OF MO IS WARM AND UNSTABLE. THIS SHOULD SUPPORT MCS MAINTENANCE INTO NRN/CNTRL AR LATER THIS MORNING. AN ADDITIONAL WW S OF WW 382 IS POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES TO MOVE SE AT 40 KT OVER SERN MO...AND WILL AFFECT PORTIONS OF NERN AR DURING THE NEXT HOUR. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED DOWNSTREAM OF WW 383 FOR ADDITIONAL WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS COLD POOL CONTINUES TO ELONGATE SEWD OVER SERN MO...WITH GUST FRONT MOVING AT APROX 40 KT. DESPITE THE FAST MOVING GUST FRONT...HI-RES RADAR IMAGERY INDICATES THAT NEW UPDRAFT GROWTH ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE COLD POOL HAS BEEN EFFICIENTLY MAINTAINED. THUS...THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES IN THE SHORT-TERM AS THE MCS ENTERS NERN AR. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE SHOW THAT A MORE STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER RESIDES OVER WRN TN...WHICH COULD RESULT IN A WEAKENING TREND AS THE MCS CROSSES THE MS RIVER LATER THIS MORNING. HOWEVER...HIGHER THETA-E VALUES OVER CNTRL AR ARE GRADUALLY SPREADING EWD...WHICH COULD BEGIN TO MODIFY THE MORE STABLE AIRMASS TO THE E. IN ADDITION...DOWNDRAFTS MAY STILL BE ABLE TO PENETRATE THE STABLE SURFACE LAYER AS UNSTABLE INFLOW AIR IS MAINTAINED ABOVE THE GROUND BY 20 KT WLY FLOW AT 1 KM AGL. ENVIRONMENTAL AND CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE NEW WW DOWNSTREAM FROM WW 383. ..GARNER.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES FOR WW 384. AREAS S AND E OF WW 384 ARE BEING MONITORED FOR AN ADDITIONAL WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SMALL FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS CONTINUES TO MOVE SE AT 30 KT OVER WRN TN. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE SHOW THAT THE MCS IS CURRENTLY POSITIONED IN A SLIGHTLY COOLER/DRIER SURFACE AIRMASS COMPARED TO AREAS W AND S. HOWEVER...SURFACE THETA-E AND MUCAPE INCREASE OVER NRN MS/AL...WITH ADDITIONAL DESTABILIZATION PROBABLE WITH THE ONSET OF DAYTIME HEATING. THUS...POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR ADDITIONAL STRENGTHENING OF THE MCS AS THE COLD POOL AND ASSOCIATED GUST FRONT ADVANCE SEWD FROM WRN TN INTO NRN MS/AL DURING THE MORNING. AREAS DOWNSTREAM FROM WW 384 ARE BEING MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE. ..GARNER.. 06/28/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
